facts.summary: Small interim data (1 CR in 4 patients), two indications deprioritized · Phase 1 · TIDAL-01 in metastatic colorectal cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The data demonstrated a 25% overall response rate (“ORR”) with durable clinical benefit and 50% disease control rate (“DCR”)
evidence.safety: There were also no new safety observations in the Phase I trial specific to TIDAL-01
evidence.program_discontinued: Turnstone is continuing to enroll multiple Phase 1 trials of TIDAL-01
